2026_02_CIN_HOU.headline: Houston reshuffles its passing game as Cincinnati brings Burrow to town
2026_02_CIN_HOU.paragraph1: Cincinnati arrives in Houston with Joe Burrow listed questionable after a back issue, although he finished the week as a full practice participant. Houston has a more disruptive availability problem: Nico Collins is out with a hamstring injury, while Jadeveon Clowney and guard Ed Ingram are also unavailable. The Bengals need to protect Burrow and keep Houston’s rush from creating long downs; the Texans must redistribute Collins’ targets without letting Cincinnati compress the field.
2026_02_CIN_HOU.model_rationale: Cincinnati’s protection against Houston’s rush and the Texans’ ability to replace Nico Collins’ target volume are the clearest swing factors for sustaining efficient passing downs.
